title: TELUS Digital Named a Leader and Star Performer in Everest Group's 2026 Trust and Safety Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment
summary: Everest Group names TELUS Digital a Leader and Star Performer in trust and safety services, citing its AI-native approach and Fuel iX™ Fortify automated AI red-teaming.
body_markdown:
**Vancouver, B.C** . **(October 27, 2026)** -[TELUS Digital](https://www.telusdigital.com/) , a global technology services provider specializing in AI-powered digital customer experiences (CX) and future-focused digital transformations, has been named a Leader for the first time in[Everest Group's Trust and Safety (T&S) Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026.](https://www.telusdigital.com/insights/trust-and-safety/resource/peak-matrix-trust-and-safety-2026) TELUS Digital was also named a Star Performer, a distinction Everest Group reserves for the providers showing the greatest year-over-year improvement on the assessment. Out of 27 evaluated T&S vendors, TELUS Digital ranked among the seven recognized as Leaders.


“TELUS Digital has a broad T&S portfolio anchored in[platform safety](https://www.telusdigital.com/solutions/platform-integrity-solutions) , AI support, and review and compliance, with a strong client presence across social media and messaging apps, gaming and legal betting, and travel and hospitality,” said Abhijnan Dasgupta, Practice Director, Everest Group. “Alongside its core T&S services, TELUS Digital brings[data for AI training](https://www.telusdigital.com/solutions/data-for-ai-training) capabilities that help enterprises develop and improve safer AI systems. TELUS Digital has invested in PRISM for moderation workflows and[Fuel iX™ Fortify](https://www.telusdigital.com/solutions/fuel-ix/fortify) for automated generative AI red teaming, supported by[Fuel iX Agent Trainer](https://www.telusdigital.com/solutions/fuel-ix/agent-trainer) ,[Fuel iX Agent Assist](https://www.telusdigital.com/solutions/fuel-ix/agent-assist) , and Fuel iX Agent Quality. Its inorganic expansion has strengthened its[content moderation](https://www.telusdigital.com/solutions/platform-integrity-solutions/content-moderation-solutions) footprint in Asia Pacific, enhancing multilingual delivery capabilities. It also maintains a comprehensive moderator wellness and workforce development framework that combines resilience-based hiring, psychologist-led interventions, trauma-informed leadership, and continued AI, policy, and technical upskilling. These are some of the factors that have contributed to TELUS Digital advancing to a Leader and being recognized as a Star Performer in Everest Group’s Trust and Safety Services PEAK Matrix® 2026.”


**TELUS Digital meets rising demand for AI safety and platform integrity expertise**


Everest Group’s report finds that growing adoption of generative and agentic AI, rising volumes of AI-generated content, more sophisticated scams and platform abuse, and heightened regulatory scrutiny are “expanding enterprise T&S requirements beyond traditional content moderation toward AI safety, responsible AI, platform integrity, and regulatory compliance.” As a result, Everest Group advises that “buyers should evaluate T&S providers as integrated risk and safety partners, rather than scaled content moderation vendors.”


TELUS Digital brings AI safety and platform integrity together, so enterprises can work with one partner from building and testing AI systems through to protecting live platforms.[Fuel iX Fortify](https://www.telusdigital.com/solutions/fuel-ix/fortify) , its proprietary automated red-teaming solution, uses trained attack and judge models to generate new adversarial tests, classify the results and recommend mitigations for AI applications and agents. TELUS Digital also provides adversarial testing services, including fraud simulation, bypass pathway mapping, bias and fairness auditing, and deepfake detection testing. The company’s[data services solutions](https://www.telusdigital.com/solutions/data-for-ai-training) supply training data and specialized labeling for safety models. These capabilities sit alongside its[platform integrity services](https://www.telusdigital.com/solutions/platform-integrity-solutions) , such as[age assurance](https://www.telusdigital.com/solutions/platform-integrity-solutions/age-assurance) and[content moderation](https://www.telusdigital.com/solutions/platform-integrity-solutions/content-moderation-solutions) .


“Trust and safety now extends to how AI systems are built, tested and governed, well beyond reviewing content after it is posted,” said Amith Nair, Global VP and GM of AI and Data, TELUS Digital. “Our clients are asking for AI safety that is built in from the start. Across our trust and safety work, that means AI handling testing and review at scale, including automated red-teaming, while people bring the judgment for the calls that matter most. Being named a Leader and Star Performer tells us our investments in AI safety and specialist talent line up with where the market is heading.”


For its Trust and Safety Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026, Everest Group evaluated and ranked 27 T&S providers as Leaders, Major Contenders or Aspirants, based on two dimensions: (a) market impact, measured through market adoption, portfolio mix and value delivered; and (b) vision and capability, measured through vision and strategy, scope of services offered, innovation and investments, and delivery footprint. The assessment draws on Everest Group's annual Request for Information (RFI) process for calendar year 2025, interactions with T&S providers, client reference checks, and its ongoing analysis of the T&S services market.
